business.name: Bonham Discount Tire and Auto
business.tagline: The shop your neighbor told you about.
business.description: New and used tires, brakes, A/C and engine work — foreign and domestic. You hear the price before we touch the vehicle, and most of it goes out the same day.

services.name: Tires & wheels
services.detail: New and used tires, custom wheels, mounting and balancing.
includes: New valve stems or TPMS service kit

services.name: Brakes & safety
services.detail: Pads, rotors, calipers and full brake inspections.
includes: Pads and rotors, front or rear
Brake fluid level and condition check

services.name: Engine & performance
services.detail: Diagnostics through engine work, foreign and domestic.

services.name: Oil & fluid service
services.detail: Conventional through full synthetic, filters and fluids.

services.name: A/C & heating
services.detail: Recharge, leak diagnosis and component replacement.
includes: Leak check with dye or electronic detector
Refrigerant oil and dryer as needed

services.name: Cooling system
services.detail: Radiators, water pumps, thermostats and hoses.
includes: Thermostat, hoses and clamps as needed

services.name: Suspension & steering
services.detail: Struts, shocks, control arms and alignments.
includes: Struts, shocks, control arms or tie rods
Torque to spec at ride height

services.name: Electrical & starting
services.detail: Batteries, starters, alternators and wiring faults.
includes: Battery load and charging system test

services.name: Diagnostics & inspection
includes: Full OBD scan, stored and pending codes
Visual inspection of the affected system
Written findings before work is quoted

services.name: Trucks & off-road
services.detail: Lift kits, oversized tires and truck-specific work.
includes: Torque to spec at ride height

coverage.heading: You know where to find us
coverage.summary: Same building on N Center St, six days a week. Drivers come to us from Honey Grove, Ector, Savoy and out past Trenton — because it's worth the drive to deal with people who tell you the truth about your car.
coverage.note: Walk in, call ahead, or just pull into the lot. We'll take a look.

testimonials.quote: These guys are awesome. I had my truck in 2 different shops and no one could or wouldn't take the time to pin point the problem. I took my truck to these guys and they went above and beyond to fix the problem. I was in tears because it felt like a brand new truck. I highly recommend them.
testimonials.name: Lisa H.

testimonials.quote: My driver side front tire was blown from hitting a pot hole. I was recommended to come here and they helped me replace it and my other bad tires at a reasonable price. The tires are still doing great and since I purchased a whole set I was given a free wheel alignment.
testimonials.name: Andy G.

testimonials.quote: If you want honesty and fair pricing this is your place. I've had many different mechanics throughout my years and they are by far the best. If something doesn't need to be fixed they won't fix it, they give you options, and they always have a positive attitude.
testimonials.name: Jonathan M.

testimonials.quote: These guys are great, and that's really an understatement. Very professional and just all around make you feel like family. Today was my first time using them and I felt as if I've known them for years. All around 100 outta 10 customer service and quality.
testimonials.name: Brandon

cta.title: Something not right with it?
cta.body: Bring it by or call and describe it. We'll tell you what's actually wrong and what it costs before you commit to anything.

headings.process: Three visits' worth of trust, in one

brands.title: Brands we fit
brands.note: Stocked or ordered same day from our distributors. If you have a set in mind, we can get it.

promise.title: In before noon, out the same day.
promise.body: Tires, brakes, oil and most routine work. Bigger jobs get a timeline before we start.
